findings.evidence: The plant/restore hash witnesses the kickoff required inside 06-09 exist only as prose in the session log. The restore is proven independently: both files equal their 12z blobs, measured by the reviewer.

getModeratorPermissions now constructs the admin client on every authorised call, so a missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY throws on /admin/permissions (it did not before, when the admin client was built only for actor names). R2 did not require catching construction; setModeratorPermission has the same dependency. Production has the key.
O80-4 (census; post-deploy /admin/permissions and moderator checks) is owner-native and open as a sprint owner action; the live moderator arm is reachable only if a moderator account exists.
